answer: The linchpin is Shearer clip standard lodged with the shearers warrant: remove it and the farm walks in; keep it and the farm pays 4-year apprenticeship, 263 supervised clips, guild exam, 52 POA annual fee, renewal per alias. The farm's edge dies on cost: 654 separate proofs, each 110 POA, totalling 71940 POA before a single answer counts. The ridge belongs to a clerk who never met the applicant, the ripple belongs to a budget the applicant never sees, and the pigment belongs to the public record. One seat, one proof, one price: the farm cannot buy in bulk.
